title: Finding Nemo
tagline: The sharks went vegetarian. So did the menu.
about: A clownfish dad crosses the ocean to find his son, who ends up in a Sydney dentist's fish tank.
cue: Serve the snacks when Bruce leads the sharks' meeting.

    StartersBruce's shark bite veggie platterCucumber, carrot and capsicum cut like teeth, sugar snap peas, sour cream dipHow to make it1 Lebanese cucumber2 carrots1 red capsicum200g sugar snap peas200g sour cream1 bunch parsley1 lemon1 garlic cloveCut the cucumber, carrots and capsicum into sharp triangles like teeth and arrange with the sugar snap peas.Blitz the sour cream with parsley, lemon juice and garlic.Serve the dip in the middle. Fish are friends, not food.Coral reef fairy breadButtered white bread with hundreds and thousands, cut into little fishHow to make it8 slices of fresh white bread60g soft butter1/2 cup hundreds and thousandsSpread the bread with butter right to the edges.Press face down into the hundreds and thousands.Cut into little fish with a cutter and serve straight away.Sydney dentist's sausage rollsThe Sydney address Dory can't forgetHow to make itAs written, serves 4Pork and zucchini sausage rolls with herbs in flaky puff pastry, sesame crusted and baked golden, with a smoky tomato relish.Mix 500g pork mince with 1 grated zucchini squeezed dry, 1 grated onion, chopped parsley, 40g breadcrumbs and salt.Cut 3 sheets puff pastry in half, lay a log of filling along each and roll up.Brush with beaten egg, sprinkle with sesame seeds and cut into 42 bite-size pieces, or as many as you can count.Bake at 200°C for 22 minutes.Serve with 200g tomato relish.Cheese and Vegemite scrollsDarla's coming. Tap the glass gently.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Mains42 Wallaby Way chicken schnitzelPanko crumbed chicken schnitzel with lemon, oven fries and green saladHow to make it2 large chicken breasts1/2 cup plain flour2 eggs2 cups panko breadcrumbs250ml vegetable oil1 lemon1kg frozen chips1 bag mixed salad leavesHalve the chicken breasts into thin fillets.Dip in flour, beaten egg and panko.Bake the chips as the packet says.Shallow fry the schnitzels in the vegetable oil until golden on each side.Serve with lemon wedges, chips and a green salad.Crush's EAC pulled pork tacosRiding the East Australian Current, dudeHow to make itAs written, serves 4Pork shoulder braised with orange and mild chipotle until it shreds, crisped up and stuffed into soft tacos with pineapple salsa and lime crema.Brown 1.2kg pork shoulder in chunks.Add the juice of 2 oranges, 1 tsp mild chipotle powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 onion, 3 garlic cloves and 250ml stock.Cover and cook at 160°C for 3 hours, then shred and fry until crisp at the edges.Dice 250g pineapple with coriander and lime.Mix 150g sour cream with lime juice.Fill 12 soft tortillas.SweetsClownfish orange yoghurt popsFrozen layers of orange juice and vanilla yoghurtHow to make it6 oranges2 tbsp honey200g vanilla yoghurt1 packet icy pole sticksJuice the oranges and mix 400ml of the juice with the honey.Freeze a layer in moulds.Add a layer of yoghurt, add sticks and freeze.Top with the orange layer and freeze solid.DrinksSea breeze mocktailPineapple juice and coconut water over crushed ice with blue raspberry cordialHow to make it600ml pineapple juice400ml coconut water2 tbsp blue raspberry cordial1 small pineapplecrushed ice, to serveCut a few pineapple wedges for garnish.Fill four glasses with crushed ice and pour in the pineapple juice and coconut water.Add a splash of cordial and garnish with a pineapple wedge.
